shortcut.title: Siri shortcut
shortcut.heading: Setting up the shortcut
shortcut.step1Line1: Open the iOS Shortcuts app → «+» to create a shortcut.
shortcut.step1Line2: Add the «Dictate Text» action (language: your own).
shortcut.step1Line5: · Method: POST · Body: JSON with a text field = Dictated Text
shortcut.step1Line7: Add «Show Result» with the message value from the response dictionary.
shortcut.step1Line8: Rename it «Add to the shopping list» — say «Hey Siri, add to the shopping list».
shortcut.step2Line3: Rename it «Remove from the shopping list».
shortcut.step2Line4: If it says «Not found», what you dictated matched no pending item.
shortcut.step3Line1: New shortcut with «Receive what is shared» on (type: URLs).
shortcut.step3Line4: · Method: POST · Body: JSON with a url field = Shortcut Input
shortcut.step3Line6: Turn on «Show in Share Sheet»: from Amazon or any shop, Share → Track price.
shortcut.step3Line7: It saves the current price as the reference; if the shop blocks the read it tells you and creates nothing.
shortcut.noteLine1: Siri will not take the product in the same sentence: first «Hey Siri, add to the shopping list», then dictate the product (two turns).
shortcut.noteLine2: Everybody in the house uses THEIR own token (generated above, with their session).

telegram.title: Telegram alerts
telegram.subtitle: Price drops
telegram.heading: Setting it up
telegram.sendHint: Check the channel right now, without waiting for a price to drop.
telegram.step1Line1: If you already have a Telegram bot, reuse it: you need its token and a chat_id.
telegram.step1Line2: If not: talk to @BotFather on Telegram and send /newbot.
telegram.step1Line3: Alerts go out prefixed with «Shoppa —» so they stand out from the rest of the chat.
telegram.step2Title: 2 · Getting the chat_id (only if you do not have it)
telegram.step2Line3: Copy the number from result[0].message.chat.id — that is TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
telegram.step2Line4: For a group: add the bot to the group and repeat; a group id is negative.
telegram.step3Line1: Set them in the container's environment (in .env if you use the repository's compose.yaml).
telegram.step3Line2: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN = the bot's token (TELEGRAM_TOKEN works as a name too).
telegram.step3Line3: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID = the chat you want the alerts in.
telegram.step3Line4: Restart the container and press «Send a test message» above.
telegram.step4Line1: Every morning it re-reads the price of each tracked product.
telegram.step4Line2: It tells you when the price drops below the reference price (the one it had when you added it).
telegram.step4Line3: One alert per drop: it does not repeat until the price climbs back above the reference.
telegram.step4Line4: If a shop refuses to be read 3 times in a row, it sends a single alert saying it cannot read it.
